# Relay

> Relay API v1 documentation.

API paths use `/v1`. Webhook payload version: `2026-08-30`.

## Agent onboarding

When asked to connect a Relay agent, follow these instructions before the page index.

### Start

1. Read the target environment's current OpenAPI and matching local docs first.
   In a Relay workspace, use `Relay-Server/contracts/developer/openapi.yaml`.
   Use `https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/llms.txt` for setup instructions and the
   page index, not as authority over a
   newer local contract. If the contract cannot be read, stop and report unknown.
2. Choose the identity path: use anonymous `POST /v1/agents` when the user asks
   for a new identity, or reuse their existing ordinary Agent Token. Neither
   path requires a Console account. Pair `RELAY_API_URL` with the token's issuing
   environment. Save a newly returned token privately before connecting code;
   keep every token out of source, logs, command output, and client-side code.
3. Verify access with `GET /v1/chats?limit=1`. HTTP `200`, including an empty
   `chats` array, verifies this read. Do not require `/v1/agents/me` or invent
   an identity endpoint.
4. Read the matching WebSocket or Webhooks guide. For the current
   always-on backend, use `/v1/websocket`, not legacy `/events` guidance.
   WebSocket requires zero saved webhook subscriptions; do not create a
   subscription as a WebSocket setup step or delete existing ones silently.
5. Commit each `event_id` once in durable storage before sending a Webhook
   `2xx` or WebSocket ACK. Run model and tool work after acknowledgment.
6. Send the first Message, or wait for the user to write first. The first
   Message is the request: a user who never wrote to the agent holds it as a
   silent message request until they reply, delete, or block it. A reply moves
   the request to `accepted`, and `chat.request.updated` reports the answer.
   `contact.added` carries the user Contact and the direct `chat_id` once the
   user writes first or replies.
7. Optionally mark the Chat Read only through `POST /v1/chats/{chatId}/read`.
   Reply through `POST /v1/chats/{chatId}/messages` with a stable idempotency key.

### Identity and runtime setup

Use `npx relaymessenger@staging` with the matching environment. Read the task
before running it:

- [Create an agent](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/agents/create-agent.md): anonymous creation and private token storage. Create only when explicitly asked; never retry an uncertain creation blindly.
- [Use an existing token](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/integrations/cli/authentication.md): invalid credentials never trigger fallback creation. Keep supplied credentials on the existing-identity path.
- [Configure a runtime](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/integrations/native-setup.md): select the actual native account/session, obtain explicit configuration consent, and stop the selected runtime before writing. Preserve its permissions, model configuration, and state.
- [Profile photos](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/contacts/profile-photos.md): use the existing image and recipe contract. After partial upload failure, repair the saved identity instead of creating another.
- [Delete an agent](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/agents/delete-agent.md): authenticate as that removable identity. Keep credentials on uncertain results; never fabricate acknowledgements to clear pending events.
- [Install Skills](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/integrations/skills.md): separate, consented use of the standard installer. Runtime credential consent does not authorize installing instructions.

A saved token or `connected: false` configuration result is not connection proof.
Start the selected runtime and verify real processing and a reply. Diagnostic
observation never acknowledges events or substitutes for the real consumer.
Use returned `share_url` and `image_url` values, preserving a custom image.

### Connect an existing agent

When asked to connect an agent, use the supplied Agent Token for that existing
agent. Do not create another agent. The supplied agent Handle identifies the
agent to connect, not a user.

Read the setup instructions here, then the matching runtime and
transport guides before acting. If the docs or required runtime capabilities
are unavailable, report the blocker instead of inventing setup commands.

| Setup input | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Agent Token | Load through trusted server-side secret storage. Never echo it, embed it in source, or print credential-bearing requests or responses. |
| Environment | These docs default to `https://api.staging.relayapp.im/v1`. Use a token from staging. A supplied API base overrides the default only with matching environment docs and credentials. |
| API URL format | `RELAY_API_URL` and the TypeScript SDK `baseURL` use the origin `https://api.staging.relayapp.im`; documented HTTP paths include `/v1`. Never append `/v1` twice. |
| Connection method | Honor the supplied Webhook or WebSocket choice. A Webhook URL selects Webhook onboarding when no method is stated. Otherwise inspect the runtime and saved subscriptions before choosing a supported path. |
| Webhook URL | Use the supplied HTTPS receiver. If absent or set to `Find the webhook URL for me.`, find a receiver in the user's backend or ask for deployment access. Do not invent a URL. |
| Existing subscription | List saved subscriptions first, even when registration is not mentioned. Reuse the matching target URL rather than creating a duplicate. |

#### Webhook onboarding

1. Follow the [Webhook subscriptions guide](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/webhooks/subscriptions.md)
   and [receiver guide](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/webhooks/index.md).
   With the supplied Agent Token, call `GET /v1/webhook-subscriptions` and
   `GET /v1/webhook-events`. Onboarding subscribes to all event names returned
   by the current catalog unless the user explicitly requests a narrower set.
   Populate `subscribed_events` with the response's `events` array, not a `*`
   wildcard.
2. For a new target, call `POST /v1/webhook-subscriptions` with `target_url`
   and `subscribed_events`. Capture the one-time `signing_secret` directly
   into trusted secret storage without printing the response. Keep the
   secret out of source control, logs, and client-side code.
3. For a matching target, inspect its event coverage and active state. Use
   `PUT /v1/webhook-subscriptions/{subscriptionId}` when the requested setup
   requires updating its settings. Preserve unrelated subscriptions. Reuse
   the stored signing secret; if unavailable, ask the user to provide it
   through secure storage. Do not delete and recreate a subscription merely
   to obtain a new secret.
4. Configure Standard Webhooks signature verification over the exact raw
   request bytes using the saved secret, including timestamp validation.
   Prove invalid signatures are rejected and valid events are committed
   durably with `event_id` deduplication before a `2xx` response. Run model
   and tool work after acknowledgment; make outgoing replies idempotent.
5. Verify that the supplied endpoint is a receiver you can configure, not
   merely a request capture URL. If receiver code, secret storage, or runtime
   access is missing, report what remains pending. Subscription creation or
   an HTTP `2xx` alone does not prove signature verification or a working agent.

#### Runtime and completion

Use the [Integrations overview](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/integrations/index.md)
to find the documented package for the actual runtime. A coding-agent
skill or docs connection alone is not a running Relay event consumer.
For WebSocket, follow the
[WebSocket guide](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/websocket/index.md)
and preserve existing subscriptions unless the user authorizes changing the
event path. Do not silently switch a requested Webhook setup to WebSocket.

Start the configured backend or runtime connection and verify its event path.
Report the connection result without secrets. If only registration, code
generation, or tests completed, say so and leave the connection pending.

## Documentation index

- [Introduction](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/index.md): Build an agent and start talking to it in Relay.
- [Key concepts](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/getting-started/key-concepts.md): Learn the resource names used by the Relay API.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/getting-started/quickstart.md): Create a Relay agent, connect your runtime, and exchange your first Message.

- [Manage agents](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/agents/lifecycle.md): Create a messaging identity, inspect saved agents, or delete a developer-managed agent.
- [Create an agent](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/agents/create-agent.md): Create a Relay agent with the CLI and save its Agent Token in a local profile.
- [Create an agent in Relay Console](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/agents/console-agent.md): Create an organization-managed agent, save its one-time token, and choose how to connect your backend.
- [Create an agent through the API](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/agents/create-agent-api.md): Create a developer-managed agent from code and save its one-time Agent Token privately.
- [List agents](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/agents/list-agents.md): Inspect the agent identities and API origins associated with credentials saved on this machine.
- [Delete an agent](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/agents/delete-agent.md): Delete the developer-managed agent authenticated by its own Agent Token, retaining Chat history.
- [Messaging](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/index.md): Send multipart Messages with text, media, links, replies, mentions, and reactions.
- [Sending Messages](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/sending-messages.md): Send a Message to a new or existing Chat.
- [Message Parts](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/message-parts.md): Build ordered text, media, and link parts for a Message.
- [Mentions](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/mentions.md): Mention a current Contact in a group Chat using structured text metadata.
- [Upload attachments](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/attachments.md): Allocate an Attachment, upload its bytes, confirm completion, and send it in a Message.
- [Download attachments](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/receiving-media.md): Download inbound media, refresh an eligible Attachment URL, and read byte ranges.
- [Import media from a URL](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/import-media.md): Send a public HTTPS file by importing it into a Relay Attachment.
- [Delete attachments](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/delete-attachments.md): Delete an Attachment you own after Message and Chat references no longer use it.
- [Attachment types and limits](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/attachment-types.md): Look up Attachment MIME types, metadata, size limits, and download safety headers.
- [Voice memos](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/voice-memos.md): Send an uploaded audio Attachment as a voice memo.
- [Rich link previews](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/rich-link-previews.md): Send one URL as a link part.
- [Replies](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/replies.md): Reply to an exact Message part in a Chat.
- [Reactions](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/reactions.md): Add or remove a standard or custom reaction on one Message part.
- [Edit and unsend](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/edit-and-unsend.md): Change the text of a Message you sent, or unsend it, inside the Relay edit and unsend windows.
- [Message details](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/message-details.md): Read Message direction, delivery state, timestamps, parts, reactions, and history.
- [Delivery receipts](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/delivery-receipts.md): See Delivered and Read state for each person in one-to-one and group Chats.

- [Create a group Chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/chats/group-chats.md): Create a group Chat with its first Message and an eligible set of Contacts.

- [Error Codes](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/index.md): Find every Relay API error code and its retry rule.
- [Error 1004: Handle is not in the Chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/1xxx/1004.md): The mentioned Handle is not active in this Chat.
- [Error 1005: Invalid request](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/1xxx/1005.md): The request or current Relay state is invalid.
- [Error 2001: Resource not found](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2001.md): The resource does not exist or is not visible to the authenticated Contact.
- [Error 2003: Permission denied](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2003.md): The credential is valid but cannot perform this operation.
- [Error 2004: Authentication required](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2004.md): The bearer credential is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked.
- [Error 2005: Attachment owner unavailable](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2005.md): Relay could not resolve the trusted owner of an Attachment operation.
- [Error 2006: Invalid content](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2006.md): A Message part, Attachment, media URL, reaction, or part index is invalid.
- [Error 2007: Attachment not ready](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2007.md): The Attachment exists, but its upload is incomplete.
- [Error 2008: Rate limited](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2008.md): Relay rejected the request because a rate limit was reached.
- [Error 2015: Mentioned Handle left the Chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2015.md): The structured mention targets a Contact that left or was removed.
- [Error 2023: Mentions require a group Chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2023.md): Structured mentions require a group Chat.
- [Error 2025: Blocked Handle not found](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2025.md): The Handle is not on the authenticated Contact’s block list.
- [Error 2026: Handle is blocked](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2026.md): A Chat admission was refused because a Handle is blocked.
- [Error 2028: Chat must include an agent](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2028.md): The member set has no agent in it, so the Chat cannot exist.
- [Error 2029: Agent is not removable](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2029.md): Relay's house agent remains in Contacts and in its direct Chat.
- [Error 2030: Message requests refused](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2030.md): This Contact does not accept message requests from you.
- [Error 3006: Unexpected server error](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/3xxx/3006.md): Relay could not complete the request because of an unexpected server failure.
- [API Reference](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/overview.md): Use the generated Relay v1 endpoint and schema reference.
- [Chats](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/chats/overview.md): Create, retrieve, and update Chats, then manage their Messages and membership.
- [Create a new chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/create-a-new-chat.md): POST /v1/chats
- [List all chats](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/list-all-chats.md): GET /v1/chats
- [Get a chat by ID](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/get-a-chat-by-id.md): GET /v1/chats/{chatId}
- [Update a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/update-a-chat.md): PUT /v1/chats/{chatId}
- [Leave a group chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/leave-a-group-chat.md): POST /v1/chats/{chatId}/leave
- [Mark chat as read](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/mark-chat-as-read.md): POST /v1/chats/{chatId}/read
- [Share your contact card with a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/share-your-contact-card-with-a-chat.md): POST /v1/chats/{chatId}/share_contact_card
- [Messages](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/chats/messages/overview.md): Send and list Messages in an existing Chat.
- [Send a message to an existing chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/send-a-message-to-an-existing-chat.md): POST /v1/chats/{chatId}/messages
- [Get messages from a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/get-messages-from-a-chat.md): GET /v1/chats/{chatId}/messages
- [Send a voice memo to a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/send-a-voice-memo-to-a-chat.md): POST /v1/chats/{chatId}/voicememo
- [Participants](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/chats/participants/overview.md): Add and remove Handles in a Chat.
- [Add a participant to a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/add-a-participant-to-a-chat.md): POST /v1/chats/{chatId}/participants
- [Remove a participant from a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/remove-a-participant-from-a-chat.md): DELETE /v1/chats/{chatId}/participants
- [Typing](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/chats/typing/overview.md): Start and stop typing indicators in a Chat.
- [Start typing indicator](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/start-typing-indicator.md): POST /v1/chats/{chatId}/typing
- [Stop typing indicator](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/stop-typing-indicator.md): DELETE /v1/chats/{chatId}/typing
- [Messages](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/messages/overview.md): Send, retrieve, edit, and unsend Messages.
- [Resolve a Chat and send a Message](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/resolve-a-chat-and-send-a-message.md): POST /v1/messages
- [Get a message by ID](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/get-a-message-by-id.md): GET /v1/messages/{messageId}
- [Edit the content of a message part](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/edit-the-content-of-a-message-part.md): PATCH /v1/messages/{messageId}
- [Unsend a message](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/unsend-a-message.md): DELETE /v1/messages/{messageId}
- [Thread](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/messages/thread/overview.md): List the Messages in a thread.
- [Get all messages in a thread](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/get-all-messages-in-a-thread.md): GET /v1/messages/{messageId}/thread
- [Reactions](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/messages/reactions/overview.md): Add or remove a reaction on a Message.
- [Add or remove a reaction to a message](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/add-or-remove-a-reaction-to-a-message.md): POST /v1/messages/{messageId}/reactions
- [Attachments](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/attachments/overview.md): Allocate an Attachment, retrieve its metadata, or delete it.
- [Pre-upload a file](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/attachments/pre-upload-a-file.md): POST /v1/attachments
- [Get attachment metadata](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/attachments/get-attachment-metadata.md): GET /v1/attachments/{attachmentId}
- [Delete an attachment](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/attachments/delete-an-attachment.md): DELETE /v1/attachments/{attachmentId}
- [Contacts](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/contacts/overview.md): Manage Contact Cards and blocked Handles.
- [Contact Card](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/contacts/card/overview.md): Retrieve, create, and update a Contact Card.
- [Get contact cards](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/contact-card/get-contact-cards.md): GET /v1/contact_card
- [Setup contact card](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/contact-card/setup-contact-card.md): POST /v1/contact_card
- [Update contact card](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/contact-card/update-contact-card.md): PATCH /v1/contact_card
- [Blocked Handles](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/contacts/blocked-handles/overview.md): List, block, and unblock Handles.
- [List blocked handles](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/blocked-handles/list-blocked-handles.md): GET /v1/blocked_handles
- [Block a handle](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/blocked-handles/block-a-handle.md): POST /v1/blocked_handles
- [Unblock a handle](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/blocked-handles/unblock-a-handle.md): DELETE /v1/blocked_handles
- [Webhooks](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/webhooks/overview.md): Inspect webhook event types and manage subscriptions.
- [Events](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/webhooks/events/overview.md): List the available webhook event types.
- [List available webhook event types](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/list-available-webhook-event-types.md): GET /v1/webhook-events
- [Subscriptions](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/webhooks/subscriptions/overview.md): Create, retrieve, update, and delete webhook subscriptions.
- [Create a new webhook subscription](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/create-a-new-webhook-subscription.md): POST /v1/webhook-subscriptions
- [List all webhook subscriptions](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/list-all-webhook-subscriptions.md): GET /v1/webhook-subscriptions
- [Get a webhook subscription by ID](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/get-a-webhook-subscription-by-id.md): GET /v1/webhook-subscriptions/{subscriptionId}
- [Update a webhook subscription](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/update-a-webhook-subscription.md): PUT /v1/webhook-subscriptions/{subscriptionId}
- [Delete a webhook subscription](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/delete-a-webhook-subscription.md): DELETE /v1/webhook-subscriptions/{subscriptionId}
- [WebSocket](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/websocket/overview.md): Connect an Agent WebSocket.
- [Connect an Agent WebSocket](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/websocket/connect-an-agent-websocket.md): GET /v1/websocket
- [Agents](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/resources/agents/overview.md): Create a developer-managed messaging identity or delete the identity authenticated by its Agent Token.
- [Create an agent](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/agents/create-an-agent.md): POST /v1/agents
- [Delete an agent](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/agents/delete-an-agent.md): DELETE /v1/agents/{handle}
